claims: Sienna Betts is the younger sister of Lauren Betts.
Sienna Betts joined Lauren Betts at UCLA in 2025.
Sienna Betts and Lauren Betts play together for the UCLA Bruins.
Lauren Betts plays center for the UCLA Bruins.
Sienna Betts plays forward for the UCLA Bruins.
Sienna Betts played high school basketball at Grandview in Colorado.
Lauren Betts has described having her sister on the floor with her as "unforgettable".
Lauren Betts has two other younger siblings named Dylan and Ashton.
The parents of Sienna Betts and Lauren Betts are Michelle and Andy Betts.
Andy Betts is a former professional basketball player.
The family of Sienna Betts and Lauren Betts moved from Spain to Colorado.
